aibaselinesurvey-1pyhln.heading: Where does your business stand on AI?
aibaselinesurvey-1pyhln.intro: Eight questions, one for each part of our method. See where you stand from Laggard to Pioneer, then take the survey away to run with your team.
aibaselinesurvey-1pyhln.point1: 8 questions, one for each part of our method.
aibaselinesurvey-1pyhln.point2: See where you stand, from Laggard to Pioneer, next to a Greatstone reference point.
aibaselinesurvey-1pyhln.point3: Download your result and the blank survey.
aibaselinesurvey-1pyhln.surveyDownloadNote: The blank survey downloads as a CSV. You can load it into Google Forms, Typeform or Formstack and send it to your leadership team. It holds the eight questions, each with four answers in order from lowest to highest. It does not score the answers or give a stage.
aibaselinesurvey-1pyhln.gateBody: Add your name and work email to see it here and download it.
aibaselinesurvey-1pyhln.dataNotice: When you press See my result, we send Greatstone your name, work email, company if you give it, and a short summary of your result: your overall stage, your strongest area and the area to move first. Your individual answers stay in your browser. We may reply once about your result. We will not add you to marketing emails.
aibaselinesurvey-1pyhln.benchmarkNote: The reference point is a Greatstone guide to help you read the chart. It is not measured data about your sector.
aibaselinesurvey-1pyhln.chartAriaLabel: Your AI readiness by pillar, scored 1 to 4, next to a Greatstone reference point. Overall {avg} of 4, {phase}. {pillar}
aibaselinesurvey-1pyhln.sentNote: Thank you. We have a summary of your result and may reply once about it.
aibaselinesurvey-1pyhln.failNote: Your result is below. We could not pass it to our team just now; email {contact} if you want to talk it through.

aicostcalculator-1qfnya.heading: How much could AI save you?
aicostcalculator-1qfnya.intro: A rough, honest estimate. Set the numbers for your team, see what the manual work costs in a year, then how much of it AI could take back.
aicostcalculator-1qfnya.hoursLabel: Hours lost per person, per week
aicostcalculator-1qfnya.gateBody: Add your name and work email to see the figure here and download it.
aicostcalculator-1qfnya.dataNotice: When you press See the figure, we send Greatstone your name, work email, company if you give it, and a summary of your estimate: the team size, hours and hourly cost you set, and the yearly figures. We may reply once about your estimate. We will not add you to marketing emails.
aicostcalculator-1qfnya.sentNote: Thank you. We have a summary of your estimate and may reply once about it.
aicostcalculator-1qfnya.failNote: Your estimate is below. We could not pass it to our team just now; email {contact} if you want to talk it through.
aicostcalculator-1qfnya.csvFooter: A guide, not a quote. The recovery rate is an assumption. A free Executive Discovery replaces these round numbers with your real ones.
aicostcalculator-1qfnya.footnote: A guide, not a quote. The recovery rate is an assumption. A free Executive Discovery replaces these round numbers with your real ones and shows which work to start with.

bookdeepdive-de8ak.headline: Send an Enquiry
bookdeepdive-de8ak.body: A few short questions. Only your name and email are required.
bookdeepdive-de8ak.sectorPlaceholder: Select if it is useful context
bookdeepdive-de8ak.messageLabel: Which work would you most like to get time back from?
bookdeepdive-de8ak.messagePlaceholder: For example: weekly reporting, proposals, social content, research
bookdeepdive-de8ak.consent: I agree that Greatstone can use these details to reply to my enquiry. See our Privacy Policy.
bookdeepdive-de8ak.sentHeading: Thank you. Your enquiry has reached us.
bookdeepdive-de8ak.sentBody: A senior member of the team will reply, usually to suggest a time for a focused thirty-minute call. If it is urgent, email us at
bookdeepdive-de8ak.failedHeading: Your message did not reach us.
bookdeepdive-de8ak.asideHeading: A considered reply, not a sales sequence.
bookdeepdive-de8ak.asideBody: Every enquiry is read by the team. We reply with a view on whether we can genuinely help, and say so plainly when we cannot.

asidePoints.title: Read by the team
asidePoints.text: Not routed into an automated nurture sequence.

asidePoints.title: A considered response
asidePoints.text: We would rather reply well than reply instantly.

asidePoints.title: No obligation
asidePoints.text: A conversation is a conversation. Nothing follows it unless you want it to.
